catches: You fund the bet yourself (monthly or upfront); the official page allows cancellation within 14 days of game start for a full refund, but not after.
Lose 10% of body weight in six months (Transformer) — verified by two-photo weigh-ins reviewed by a referee; miss it and your money is gone.
Payout is conditional: only winners split the pot; there is no guaranteed profit and most players' expected return is negative.
This is not income — it is a conditional prize tied to a health outcome.
Health risks: rapid weight loss can be dangerous; get medical clearance before attempting.
